description_en: Queries and updates the ICP filing status of an accelerated domain name
description_zh: 调用UpdateDomainState接口更新加速域名的ICP备案状态
kebab_example: aliyun ga update-domain-state --domain www.example.com --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateDomainState

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name whose ICP filing status you want to update
parameters.help_zh: 待更新ICP备案状态的加速域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

State.description_en:
The ICP filing status of the accelerated domain name. Valid values:

illegal: The domain name is illegal.

inactive: The domain name has not completed ICP filing.

active: The domain name has a valid ICP number.

unknown: The ICP filing status is unknown
State.description_zh:
加速域名的ICP备案状态。
illegal：违规。
inactive：未备案。
active：已备案。
unknown：未知
